answer: The owner keeps a second seed phrase that opens a small decoy wallet holding little value, while the real funds sit behind the true phrase. Under pressure the owner can hand over the decoy, and the attacker cannot tell it apart from the real one. A Sybil farm cannot use decoys to multiply identities, since each decoy still needs its own real wallet behind it. Trust here is built the way a anchor is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. The canyon hides nothing and the bridge reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
